list_free_games.description: List the games you can claim for free on the Epic Games Store right now, with when each giveaway ends and the store link to claim it. Sales and games that are always free are left out.
list_free_games.display_str_template: List the Epic Games Store's free games.

games.description: Bad Cheese is a psychological horror inspired by the eerie charm of 1920s animation.
games.title: Bad Cheese

list_free_games.name: list_free_games

parameters.description: The store to look at: it sets the prices and currency, and a few games are not free everywhere. Leave empty for the United States.
parameters.name: country

options.label: South Georgia & the South Sandwich Islands

parameters.description: The language of game titles, descriptions and store links. Leave empty for English.
parameters.name: language

country.description: The two-letter code of the country looked at, e.g. US.

games.description: The games, one entry each: free now ending soonest first, or upcoming starting soonest first.

currency.description: The three-letter code of the price's currency, e.g. USD.

description.description: The store's short description of the game.

free_from.description: When the giveaway starts, in UTC (e.g. 2026-10-15T15:00:00Z).

free_until.description: When the giveaway ends, in UTC (e.g. 2026-10-22T15:00:00Z).

id.description: The store's id for the game.

is_mystery.description: True for a Mystery Game: the store keeps its title secret until the giveaway starts.

namespace.description: The store's id for the game's publisher catalogue.

original_price.description: What it usually costs, written the local way, e.g. $19.99.

original_price_amount.description: What it usually costs, as a number, e.g. 19.99.

seller.description: Who sells it on the store.

store_url.description: The game's store page, where it is claimed. Empty for a Mystery Game, whose page appears when it is revealed.

type.description: Game, Edition, Bundle, Add-on, Demo or Other.

language.description: The language the titles are in, e.g. en-US.

list_upcoming_free_games.description: List the games the Epic Games Store has announced will be free next, with the date and time each giveaway starts and ends. A Mystery Game is listed too, with its title kept secret until it starts.
list_upcoming_free_games.display_str_template: List the Epic Games Store's upcoming free games.

games.description: A first-person horror shooter for up to four players.
games.title: Sker Ritual
